name: coming-later
title: Coming-later rows
description: Pages that are planned but not written yet appear greyed out on the home page and in the page switcher.

statuses.description: Page statuses shown as coming later.

label.description: Badge on the row; per-page override with "statusLabel" in site.json.

inPicker.description: List them (disabled) in the page switcher.

searchable.description: Let search find them (with placement "after", they otherwise disappear while searching).

placement.description: "group": each planned page sits in its group, greyed out. "after": all planned pages in one row block below the catalog (hidden while a filter is on; while searching too unless searchable).

afterTitle.description: Optional small heading above the "after" block.
